description: Derive the feature branch name deterministically in code as cam/issue-<prd.issueNumber> (no slug), removing the planner LLM as the source of branch names and eliminating orphan remote branches.

officialDocsConsulted.summary: Confirmed `git checkout -B <branch>` semantics: same as -b except it resets the branch to the start point (default HEAD) instead of failing when the branch already exists. This is the idempotent re-plan behavior the spec requires; discarding unpushed commits from a prior attempt of the same branch is the intended reset.

userStories.title: Derive branch name in code as cam/issue-<N> with checkout -B and missing-issueNumber gate
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the plan-runner to construct the feature branch name deterministically in code as cam/issue-<prd.issueNumber> (no slug) and create it idempotently, so that every plan attempt for the same issue converges on one branch name and orphan branches stop accumulating on the remote.
acceptanceCriteria: The post-audit path derives the branch name in code as the literal string cam/issue-<issueNumber> from prd.issueNumber (typeof number); the prd.branchName string authored by the planner LLM is no longer what drives git checkout. Unit test asserts the derived name given issueNumber. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

executeGitProceedBranch spawns git checkout -B <branch> (capital B, recreate from current HEAD) instead of -b, so re-planning the same issue with the branch already existing does not fail with 'already exists'. Test asserts the exact argv shape ['checkout', '-B', 'cam/issue-<N>']. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

When prd.issueNumber is null, absent, or not a number, the plan is barred with an explicit error: notifyFn receives a message naming the missing issueNumber, no git checkout is spawned, and no branch is created (no slug or ad-hoc fallback). Test asserts zero git calls and the notify message. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

Before the prd.json commit in executeGitProceedBranch, the derived name is written back into prd.json branchName, so the committed PRD and downstream readers (status, dashboard, ship, suggestions source) stay coherent with the real branch even if the planner emitted something else. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/plan/]

The cam/ namespace prefix-matching is untouched: src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts still lists refs/heads/cam/ exactly as before (no diff in that file). [oracle: git diff --stat main -- src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts prints nothing]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts (executeGitProceedBranch ~line 1036 changes -b to -B; RunPostAuditOptions field ~line 961 switches from trusting prd.branchName to deriving from issueNumber; the empty-branchName guard at ~line 1259 is replaced by the explicit missing-issueNumber gate), src/commands/sidecar.ts runPostPlanActions ~lines 1788-1794 (today reads prdRaw.branchName; switch to reading prdRaw.issueNumber and deriving, or pass issueNumber down for plan-runner to derive; keep all git calls behind the injected spawnFn per patterns.md US-R1-001). Tests: test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner.test.ts and plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts assert argv shapes; update the '-b' expectations to '-B' and add the gate cases. Gotchas: (1) checkout -B resets the branch to current HEAD and discards unpushed commits from a prior attempt of the SAME branch; this is intentional re-plan behavior per ADR-0016, do not add protection; plan-preflight has already checked out main and pulled, so HEAD is fresh main. (2) noUncheckedIndexedAccess: guard every indexed access. (3) Branch is an opaque string everywhere else in src/ (nothing parses slug or number out of it); do not touch other consumers. Re-check ADR-0016 (relatedDocs) before coding.

userStories.title: Update planner and auditor templates to the cam/issue-<N> contract and re-embed vendor
userStories.description: As a cam operator, I need the planner template to stop instructing the LLM to invent cam/pr-<N>-<slug> names and the auditor template to validate the strict ^cam/issue-<N>$ format, so that the agent-facing contract matches the code-derived naming and the auditor blocks any drift.
acceptanceCriteria: templates/agents/subagent-planner.md no longer contains the string cam/pr-<N>-<slug>; the output schema instructs branchName as cam/issue-<issueNumber> derived from the issue number. [oracle: ! grep -q 'cam/pr-' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md && grep -q 'cam/issue-' templates/agents/subagent-planner.md]

templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md check 14 validates branchName against ^cam/issue-<N>$ (number only): no slug variant and no cam/<slug> no-issue fallback remain. [oracle: ! grep -q 'cam/pr-' templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md && ! grep -q 'cam/<slug>' templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md]

The mirror copies .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md and .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md receive the same line-level edits (planner line ~32, auditor line ~82). [oracle: ! grep -q 'cam/pr-' .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md]
src/vendor/_generated.ts is regenerated after the template edits (bun run embed-vendor) and the drift check passes. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
userStories.notes: Files: templates/agents/subagent-planner.md (line 32), templates/agents/subagent-auditor.md (line 82, check 14 under section E. Repo invariants), .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md (line 32), .claude/agents/subagent-auditor.md (line 82), src/vendor/_generated.ts (regenerated, never hand-edited). Gotchas: (1) cam dual-copy is per-file: the .claude/ and templates/ copies of these files are NOT byte-identical overall; edit only the branchName lines in each copy, do not sync whole files. (2) Vendor re-embed is mandatory: both templates have embedded copies in src/vendor/_generated.ts (~lines 26 and 29); embed-vendor:check fails if stale, regenerate with bun run embed-vendor. (3) This very PR was planned pre-change and ships under the old-format branch name; the new naming only affects PRDs planned after merge + rebuild, which is expected per the issue gotchas.
